svg.title: Visual abstract: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak declared PHEIC, May 2026
svg.desc: A visual abstract summarizing the current Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in DRC and Uganda, its PHEIC declaration, high fatality, and urgent research gaps in diagnostics, vaccines, and antivirals.
svg.text: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) - Public Health Emergency of International Concern
No targeted treatment approved for BDBV
